cookies.description: Optional. Your own Instagram cookies as JSON. They are needed to read replies, and for posts that a visitor who is not signed in cannot open (a private account you follow, an age check). Leave empty to read the comments of public posts. Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}, ...]
cookies.title: Instagram Cookies (Optional)

includeReplies.description: Also read the replies under each comment. Instagram lists replies only to a signed-in visitor, so this needs the cookies below; without them the comments are read and the log says that no replies are read.
includeReplies.title: Include Replies

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of comments to read per post (1-100,000). Replies are read in addition to this number. Reading 100,000 comments takes about an hour.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max Comments Per Post

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Maximum number of replies to read per comment thread (1-1,000), when Include Replies is on. For example, 5 means at most 5 replies per comment.
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max Replies Per Comment

postUrls.description: Instagram post, reel or IGTV URLs to scrape comments from. Accepts /p/, /reel/, /reels/, /tv/, and canonical username/p/shortcode formats. Duplicates are silently de-duplicated. A bare shortcode also works.
postUrls.title: Instagram Post URLs
